questions.question: Which of the following is a common indicator that a chemical reaction has taken place?
options: The mixture is stirred
The volume remains exactly constant
A change in colour or temperature
The state of matter stays identical

questions.question: What happens to atoms during a chemical reaction?
options: They are destroyed and replaced by new atoms
They rearrange themselves to form new substances
They melt into a single large super-atom
They remain in the exact same bonds but change their elements

questions.question: Which of the following is generally true about chemical reactions?
options: They can easily be reversed by freezing
They are irreversible
They always happen instantly in under a second
They only occur when metals are mixed together

questions.question: What three components are required to initiate a combustion reaction?
options: Fuel, carbon dioxide, and water
Fuel, oxygen, and an initial heat source
Nitrogen, oxygen, and a spark
Carbon, hydrogen, and an electrical current

questions.question: What does the term 'burning' commonly describe in chemistry?
options: The reaction of substances with oxygen, typically producing visible flames
The decomposition of a substance using strong electrical currents
The physical melting of a solid into a liquid without chemical change
The process of dissolving a metal in a highly concentrated acid

questions.question: If a chemical reaction involves reactants containing carbon and oxygen atoms, which gas is commonly formed?
options: Hydrogen
Nitrogen
Carbon dioxide
Sulfur dioxide

questions.question: What occurs during a decomposition reaction?
options: Two elements combine to form a single complex compound
A single compound breaks down into two or more products
An insoluble solid forms when two clear liquids are mixed
A fuel reacts rapidly with oxygen to release heat and light

questions.question: When a metal carbonate is heated and undergoes decomposition, what are the typical products?
options: A metal oxide and carbon dioxide gas
Pure metal and oxygen gas
Metal hydroxide and hydrogen gas
Metal chloride and water vapour

questions.question: What is the term for a chemical reaction where a substance combines with oxygen?
options: Decomposition
Reduction
Oxidation
Precipitation

questions.question: Which of the following are both examples of oxidation reactions?
options: Combustion and rusting
Melting and boiling
Neutralisation and filtration
Evaporation and condensation

questions.question: What type of reaction occurs when two solutions are mixed together and form an insoluble solid?
options: Combustion reaction
Precipitation reaction
Decomposition reaction
Oxidation reaction

questions.question: Why are precipitation reactions useful in water treatment facilities?
options: They increase the temperature of the water to kill all bacteria
They remove unwanted dissolved substances by turning them into solids
They add oxygen gas to the water to make it fizzy
They dissolve large plastic objects into harmless liquids

questions.question: In any chemical reaction, how does the total mass of the products compare to the total mass of the reactants?
options: The mass of the products is always slightly less due to energy loss
The mass of the products is always double the mass of the reactants
The mass of the products is exactly the same as the mass of the reactants
The mass of the products is always greater because new atoms are made

questions.question: What do chemical equations represent about a reaction?
options: How long the reaction will take to complete
The safety precautions needed during the experiment
How the atoms in the reactants rearrange to form the products
The exact cost of the chemicals used in the laboratory

questions.question: What is the meaning of the arrow symbol in a chemical equation?
options: Equals the cost of
Changes into
Is added to
Remains identical to
